overview:
A winter weekend trek from Delhi: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** Chopta, Tungnath and Chandrashila group trip leaves Delhi in the evening by AC Traveller and gets you back early on Day 4.

Day 1 starts with breakfast at Devprayag, where the Bhagirathi meets the Alaknanda, then continues via Dhari Devi Temple to a scenic campsite in Chopta (8,790 ft). Day 2 is the trek to Tungnath, the world's highest Shiva temple at 12,073 ft, and on to Chandrashila Peak at 12,110 ft, weather permitting. Day 3 is the Deoria Tal trek from Sari village before the evening drive back. Stays, travel, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, and a tour coordinator are included. Prices start at ₹5,500 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra), and you reserve with a ₹3,000 advance.

itinerary.title: Departure to Chopta
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point, meet your team captain and the group, and depart in the evening by AC Traveller.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).
Overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Devprayag and Chopta
itinerary.content:
Morning arrival at Devprayag for breakfast and the sangam of the Bhagirathi and Alaknanda.
Journey to Chopta via Dhari Devi Temple.
Check in to the scenic Chopta campsite and explore nature with the group.
Back to the stay for dinner.

itinerary.title: Trek to Tungnath and Chandrashila
itinerary.content:
Early start with the sunrise, then breakfast.
Trek to Tungnath, the world's highest Shiva temple, and pay your respects.
Climb on to Chandrashila Peak (12,110 ft, weather permitting).
Back to the stay for dinner.

itinerary.title: Deoria Tal trek and departure
itinerary.content:
Breakfast, check out and depart for Sari village, the base for Deoria Tal.
Trek to Deoria Tal, enjoy the views, then trek back to Sari.
Evening departure for Delhi. Reach early on Day 4.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Pickup is from Delhi, with departure in the evening by AC Traveller and a dinner halt on the way (not included). Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip. You reach Devprayag the next morning.

faqs.q: How much does the Chopta Tungnath trip cost?
faqs.a: On regular dates, ₹5,500 per person on quad sharing, ₹6,000 on triple sharing and ₹6,500 on double sharing. Christmas (24 and 25 December) and New Year (30 December) departures have their own price, shown when you pick that date. 5% GST is extra.

2 nights in a homestay or camp, transfers to and from Delhi in an AC Traveller (AC off in the hills), 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, the trek to Tungnath and Chandrashila, a tour coordinator, and extra mattresses for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: Which treks are part of the trip?
faqs.a: Day 2 is the trek to Tungnath (12,073 ft) and on to Chandrashila Peak (12,110 ft), weather permitting. Day 3 is the trek from Sari village to Deoria Tal and back. Wear running or outdoor shoes with good grip.
Chopta nights are freezing. Pack a down jacket, thermals, socks and gloves; gear like jackets, shoes, walking sticks and ponchos is not included, so bring or rent it.
Both nights are at a campsite in Chopta (8,790 ft) or a homestay. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing; early check-in is not included.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Pay a ₹3,000 per person advance to reserve your seat, by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, and clear the balance 24 hours before boarding. By paying the advance you accept the terms and conditions. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances, and there are no refunds for inclusions you don't use. Bookings can't be transferred: only the names given at confirmation may travel.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Nights are cold, so pack a down jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, running or outdoor shoes for the trek and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
